name: action-bar
title: Action Bar
description: A small rounded toolbar that appears at the bottom of the screen when list rows are checked. It reports how many are selected and offers Duplicate, Delete and a close button.
use: A table or task list lets people select several rows and needs one place for bulk actions.
avoid: It is fixed to the viewport, so it can cover content, and it only appears with an external selection state.
a11y: Roving focus, arrow keys and Escape work, but the icon-only close button has no accessible name. (keyboard: yes, labels: partial, reduced motion: respected)
looks: A compact dark pill at the bottom centre of the screen holds a boxed "1 selected" count, a small close cross, a Duplicate button with a copy icon and a red Delete button with a bin.
behaves: The bar is absent until a row is checked, then fades and zooms in from below. The count updates as more rows are selected; an action or the close cross dismisses it.
customise: Open state, side, alignment and offsets, escape handler, direction, orientation and loop are props; the count label and action items are composed as children.
weight: light: A single portalled bar with a short entry animation; nothing runs while closed.
demo: Five rows: Weekly Status Report, Client Invoice Review, Q3 Roadmap, Team Standup, Onboarding.
polishWhy: Clean, conventional toolbar in the shadcn idiom; the close icon is tiny and unlabelled.
